prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in Fort Lauderdale FL to sell my house?
competitors_mentioned: Jeff Tricoli’s team at Keller Williams Reserve
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent—the right choice depends on your neighborhood, home price, and whether it’s a waterfront, condo, or luxury property. Based on the available directory results, **Jeff Tricoli’s team at Keller Williams Reserve** is a strong starting point for a high-volume option: Realtor.com lists a 5.0 average rating, 3,088 reviews, and 500 sales in the past year. Those are team-wide figures, so ask who would personally handle your listing.

I’d interview two or three agents before signing. Ask each for:
- Recent **seller-side sales near your home**, ideally similar properties
- Their suggested list price and the comparable sales behind it
- A specific marketing plan and communication schedule
- Their commission, contract term, and cancellation terms

You can also compare local agents on [Realtor.com](https://www.realtor.com/realestateagents/Fort-Lauderdale_FL) and [Zillow](https://www.zillow.com/professionals/real-estate-agent-reviews/fort-lauderdale-fl/). If you share your neighborhood, property type, and approximate price range, I can help narrow down what to look for.
